Package dev.turboism.sdk.event

Interface EventBus

public interface EventBus
Typed event bus for plugin-to-plugin and framework-to-plugin communication.

Publication and subscription require distinct permissions. The runtime schedules listener delivery through plugin task policy, so publishers must not assume synchronous delivery or a host UI thread. Close each returned registration, preferably through a plugin disposable scope.

      Subscribes to events of one exact event type.
      Type Parameters:
      T - event type

      type - non-null event class
